answer: A proof-of-work onboarding gate resists Sybil attacks by charging every new identity a real cost before it can trade: each agent must finish a chain of small, peer-verified tasks - a meadow of tiny jobs that takes hours of honest compute. One agent pays this once and gains full trading rights, but an attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must pay it a thousand times, in sable server bills and wasted hours, while the cost spiral stays flat for legitimate users.
